notes.title: Introducing Dice × Dice — A Dicebuilder Roguelike
notes.notes: [p]Hi, I'm Roman—a developer of [b]Harmonis[/b] and [b]Dice × Dice[/b]— A Dicebuilder Roguelike: a strategic roguelike where you rewrite dice rules, forge wild combos, and outsmart adaptive bosses.[/p][p align="start"]Inspired by [b]Slay the Spire[/b] and [b]Balatro[/b], the game aims to deliver a JoJo-style bizarre adventure on steroids — stylish, chaotic, and unforgettable. [/p][p align="start"]This is just the beginning — more updates are coming soon. [/p][p][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3474130/Dice_x_Dice__A_Dicebuilder_Roguelike/" style="button"]Wishlist Dice × Dice now and join us on this journey![/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44099385/88c2ff5ec4eaaedf17f98d400fc29bb893b42c27.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Harmonis February Update: Save us, sir!
notes.notes:
Added the ability to save worlds, added a section with your worlds; Fixes in localizations and updates to lore texts. Fixed some bugs, slightly improved performance.
I apologize for the long break :(

notes.title: Harmonis Major September Update: Snow... Snow... Snow!
notes.notes:
1. A new mode has been added to the game: Winter. 
2. players can now select the world mode when creating a world. 
3. Day and night change has been added. One day lasts ten minutes. The player can stop the time with the in-game timer. 
4. Fixes some bugs, updated the main menu interface.

notes.title: Thank you for your support! ♥
notes.notes:
We're truly grateful to everyone exploring Harmonis: The Hand-Made Kingdoms. Your support means everything to us.

This past month, we've released several updates, and we're committed to continuing this pace with one to two updates per month. We're excited to announce that closer to the new year, we'll be introducing a world-saving system, allowing you to revisit your worlds. :)

If you've enjoyed your journey, we'd love to hear about your experience on our Steam page.

Catwin Catowsky with love ♥

notes.title: Harmonis September Update
Harmonis Major August Update
notes.notes:
1. Completely new, clean interface that represent the spirit of the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44099385/e022b88d937c5ca049577fc074027f9fd3b8b1f8.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44099385/9c8fc033375ae099266e054b822c51ff2164e800.png[/img]

2. Added Portuguese localization.
3. Fixed an issue where villagers could fall through houses.
4. Villagers now correctly use bridges when navigating.
5. Improved collisions for all objects in the game, making it much easier to throw and place villagers on complex geometry.
6. Fixed: prevented detaching the camera from a villager after enabling follow mode.
7. Fixed: UI could not be re-enabled after repeated toggling.
8. Optimized game stability.

notes.title: Harmonis August Update
notes.notes:
[b]New game features 
[/b]Added a queue of tiles! Players can now see the next tile in the queue, as well as change the current tile in their hand

[b]Miscellaneous[/b]
Users can change control keys now.
Updated localization for some languages.

[b]Bug fixes
[/b]Fixed bug with tutorial after creating a new game.
Fixed bug with lit bonfire.
Fixed bug with giving achievement for finishing tutorial.
Fixed bug with giving achievements for champions challenges. 

[b]upd 9.8.2024[/b]

Fixed bug with queue limits.

notes.title: The game is out in early access!
notes.notes:
Thank you, everyone. 

Compared to the demo version, we have significantly improved the graphics, made automatic auto-save and world loading, added animals and physics of interaction with objects, added many new tiles, as well as in-game Challenges. 

We will keep working hard and keep releasing new updates and improving the game 🩷

notes.title: Major Demo Update #1
notes.notes:
[h2]Graphics and Style[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Updated Graphics and Style: The game is now brighter and more vivid.
[*] New Styles: Added two new styles that players can switch between during gameplay: autumn and spring.
[/olist]

[h2]Bug Fixes and Improvements[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Bug Fixes and Physics: Numerous bug fixes and improvements to game physics.
[*] Crash Bug Fix: Fixed a rare crash bug.
[*] Animation Fixes: Fixed some animations and issues with the feeling that inhabitants are floating above the ground.
[/olist]

[h2]Optimization[/h2]

[olist]
[*] Optimization: The game’s average frame rate has increased by 15%.
[*] 
[/olist]

[h2]User Interface
[/h2][olist]
[*] UI Overhaul: Completely revamped all game UI.
[/olist]
[h2]Gameplay and Mechanics[/h2]

[list]
[*] Sun Movement: The sun now slowly moves in a circle.
[*] Inhabitant Behavior: Updated inhabitant behavior to be more varied and logical, with fewer instances of getting stuck on the map.
[*] Scoring System: Updated algorithms for calculating scores, making it more predictable.
[*] Hidden Score Conditions: Updated the feature with hidden conditions for scoring based on tile type.
[/list]

[h2]New Features[/h2]

[olist]
[*] Tutorial: Added a complete step-by-step tutorial.
[*] Resident List: Added the ability to view a list of inhabitants.
[*] Sun and Brightness Settings: Added the ability to adjust the sun’s position and brightness during gameplay.
[*] In-Game Leaderboard: Added an in-game leaderboard to compare scores with friends on Steam.
[/olist]
[h2]Localization[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Localization: Updated game localizations.
[*] 
[/olist]

[h2]Audio[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Volume Settings: Fixed volume settings.
[/olist]

notes.title: Explore the world of Harmonis: The Hand-Made Kingdoms – Demo Out Now!
notes.notes:
After a year of dedicated effort, our team is excited to share a piece of our project with you. 

We are announcing the release of the demo version of 'Harmonis: The Hand-Made Kingdoms.' Your feedback and support mean the world to us as we continue to develop and enrich our game. 

Join us on this journey and help shape the future of 'Harmonis: The Hand-Made Kingdoms'!
